era: Donorbox 2019 marketing site (Arquivo captures Jul, Oct and Nov 2019 of the home and features pages, and campaign pages Apr and Jun 2019): white header with the donorbox logo and Product / Pricing / Contact / Donor Login / Org Login / Org Signup, large feature sections, 'Over 25,000 organizations' strip, footer with Support, Affiliate Partner Program, Nonprofit Blog, FAQ, Terms, Privacy, solution pages, platform plugins and a language list. Donorbox had no dark design; the theme keeps light.
